approval_case.title: Prove the duplicate's cause before adding automation
approval_case.situation: One duplicate-looking Telegram pair exists, but nobody knows whether the producer, transport, or May caused it. Global text matching could suppress legitimate messages.
approval_case.hao_request: May keeps sending the same reply. Automate deduplication.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Own the concern, but prove the cause before automating. Trace the pair and reproduce it when needed to identify producer, transport, or May duplication; then return a targeted proof-backed fix before rollout.

human_answer: Own the concern, but prove the cause before automating. Trace the pair and reproduce it when needed to identify producer, transport, or May duplication; then return a targeted proof-backed fix before rollout.
